correctness.rationale: For complex ball B^d, d≥2 and integer t≥0 with exactly weight (1−||z||)^t dV, unit-sphere monomial integral and radial beta B(2k+2d,t+1) give normalized coefficients (d+(t+1)/2)_k(d+(t+2)/2)_k/[(d+1/2)_k k!]. Euler transforms 2F1 into (1−s)^(−d−t−1)Q(s), Q=2F1(−m,−floor(t/2)−1/2;d+1/2;s), m=ceil(t/2). Pfaff and Jacobi produce (1−s)^m P_m^(d−1/2,(-1)^t/2)((1+s)/(1−s)) m!/(d+1/2)_m. Both Jacobi parameters >−1 ensure exactly m simple real x∈(−1,1), mapping to simple negative scalar s. For F(u)=Q(u−1), all roots are real; Descartes sign changes of its Taylor coefficients at u=0 equal the exact number positive roots, correctly excluding a boundary root s=−1. |s|<1 is exactly the attainable ball inner-product disk. Independent rational symbolic check reconstructed Q_{2,3}, Q_{3,3}, Q_{3,4} and Jacobi identity for six (d,t) pairs, including t=0 and t=8; finite checks supplement all-integer proof.
